name: code-modernization-delphi
description: Unattended migration of small Delphi ETL systems to Java: a router dispatches analyze, audit, transform, verify and fix agents, checks each stage by script, and proves equivalence with the upstream code-modernization comparison and proof pack. Project knowledge (mapping rules, template, how to run and capture both programs) lives in a domain-knowledge skill.
